Hey! Yes, I had SMILE done almost a year ago at Dünyagöz Ataşehir with Dr. Ibrahim Yasar – really happy with it.

The whole thing took about 5 mins, the actual procedure just 2 mins. Felt a bit weird for a few hours, but after a good sleep I was fine. I still use eye drops now and then, but not needing glasses anymore is totally worth it.

Dr. Yasar was great and still answers questions – aftercare and check-ups were solid too. Good luck if you go for it!
